description: Create an empty board in the workspace, to leave the user a view of what you found; fill it with add_panel, where each panel says which projects it reads. First decide what kind of board the request is, from the decision the user wants to make with it: "launch" when one feature or release just shipped: is it used, by whom, does it convert, did it break anything; "conversion" when a funnel someone cares about: where people drop and which segment converts; "growth" when the business at a glance: new people, active people, conversions and money over time; "engagement" when how much and how often people use the product, and whether they come back; "revenue" when money: how much, from whom, and the path to paying; "acquisition" when where people come from and which channels bring the ones who sign up; "reliability" when what is breaking and whether it hurts the flows that matter; "custom" when none of the above: a board shaped around one specific question. The result is a plan for that kind, filled in with the project's own signup, activation, conversion and revenue events: follow it, dropping what the user did not ask about. If the request fits none, ask the user what the board is for before building. Pass `expiresInDays` for a board built for one launch, so it deletes itself afterwards instead of staying forever. Only do this when the user asked for a board or agreed to one.

description.description: One sentence saying what the board is for, at most 100 characters. It is the line under the board's title; a person can edit it in Vinktar.

expiresInDays.description: Delete the board this many days from today. Leave it out for a board that stays. A person can change or clear the date in Vinktar.

kind.description: What the board is for; decides the plan that comes back.

project.description: Project handle (as in list_projects) or id. Optional when this connection is limited to one project or the workspace has only one.

projects.description: Project handles (as in list_projects) or ids, to read across several apps. Leave out for every project this connection can reach. For one project use `project`; never pass both.
